top_choice_rationale: P001 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) rewards a coherent, mature discovery chain: Holst on GLP-1 physiology and insulinotropic action, Mojsov on the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) form, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide biology and receptor pharmacology. Its clinical consequence is replicated in several independent randomized programmes for glycaemia, weight, and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The main weakness is attribution (Knudsen omitted, Mojsov priority versus Habener unverified from the supplied record), but a citation worded strictly around discovery and mechanism handles this, and it is clearly preferable to no award.
